name: Test - While we're closed
description: The chat opens while closed. Email question, ticket, close. Created OFF so it does not take over live chats; switch it on to test.

ask.text: Leave your email and we'll reply first thing.

bye.text: Thanks! We'll be in touch at {Email}.
